subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 6 updates

question: Should this PR be completed by advancing the downloaded TruffleHog runtime and its verified digest to v3.96.0, or should the wrapper-only update be deferred?
rationale: The CI job executes a separately pinned security scanner artifact, so selecting and verifying its exact release digest is a security-boundary decision that should not be inferred from the action-wrapper update alone.

options.title: Align the runtime scanner
options.body: Verify the upstream v3.96.0 asset and digest, update the explicit download together with the action pin, and rerun the secret-scan workflow.

options.title: Defer the TruffleHog upgrade
options.body: Revert the wrapper-only pin and retain the known v3.95.9 action-and-binary pair until an owner can verify the v3.96.0 runtime artifact.

recommendation.title: Align the runtime scanner
recommendation.body: Verify the upstream v3.96.0 asset and digest, update the explicit download together with the action pin, and rerun the secret-scan workflow.

likelyOwner.reason: Best available routing candidate for the repository-side CI security decision; file-level ownership evidence was not available from the read-only inspection environment.
